systems.name: Sun + Earth–Moon barycentre (J2000)
systems.modelNote: Two-body model: Sun + Earth–Moon barycentre; positions are barycentres; not a forecast of Earth's real position. The Moon, the other planets, relativity and non-gravitational forces are absent; a real velocity change would act on two bodies.
systems.description: How does changing a planet's initial velocity affect its subsequent orbit? The baseline is the Sun and the Earth–Moon barycentre at J2000.0; the modified run scales the barycentre's initial speed and keeps its direction.
